proposals.evidence: CDIAL 5301.1 jyotsnā gives Prakrit joṇhā/juṇhā moonlight, Jaunsari jhūn, Nepali jun moon and Halbi jon moon. The selected regional jh-un/jan/jon/janha/join forms fit this branch, preserving breathy h, final vowels and source vowel notation. Moon versus moonlight is a documented semantic extension within the family. Local Indo-Aryan transmission remains unresolved. Exact response: jɦuṇ.
